id.desc: ID of the usergroup to remove users from

users.desc: The encoded user IDs to remove from the usergroup, provided as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. _Maximum:_ `15000`

desc: Remove members from an existing organizational usergroup. This method is only available to Enterprise Grid organizations.

errors.feature_not_enabled: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this workspace.
errors.invalid_usergroup: A usergroup with the specified ID does not exist.
errors.invalid_users: One or more users provided can not be removed from the usergroup.
errors.not_an_enterprise: The token passed in does not belong to an Enterprise organization.
errors.restricted_action: The calling user cannot modify the specified usergroup, or the usergroup's membership is managed by an identity provider (IdP) and can only be changed through SCIM.
errors.user_not_found: One or more users provided are invalid or are not a member of the organization.
